the author's own proof environment immediately following the proposition: the Quot functor is an fppf sheaf (quot-sheaf lemma); passing to the associated stack in groupoids, the algebraic stacks proposition reduces to showing the stack is algebraic; the forgetful 1-morphism to the coherent sheaves stack (an algebraic stack by the general theorem) suffices to be representable by algebraic spaces; for a scheme T and object (h, G) the 2-fibre product is a stack in setoids whose sheaf of sets assigns to T'/T the surjections F_{T'} -> G_{T'}, and this sheaf is an open subspace (surjectivity-open lemma) of the Hom algebraic space (source lines 2539-2588)
